cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Technically, Yes
cards.instruction: Comply with every agreement in the narrowest possible way while insisting you honored it completely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I watered the fern you pointed at. Your holiday watering is done.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant every plant, every day until Sunday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Certainly. One teaspoon per plant each day through Sunday. That covers them all.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Use a full can on each. And empty the saucers afterwards.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. I'll empty the saucers on Sunday. You specified daily watering, not daily emptying.

mechanism: A frames literal minimal plant care as teaching the owner to close wording gaps, correcting the pupil only after exploiting each gap.
confusable: It is deliberate narrow compliance, not novice confusion about plants.
comparison: Placement and packing loopholes versus dose and schedule.
seedUse: D47 fern/teaspoon/full can/saucer timing; S05 a teacher of explicit requests.
